Click-n-speak needs to hear your speech.

Click «Request Access» — macOS will show a permission dialog. Click Allow.

wizard.perm_access_body:
Accessibility lets Click-n-speak type transcribed text into any app.

Click «Open Settings» — System Settings will open on the Accessibility page.

  1. Find Click-n-speak in the list
  2. Toggle it ON
  3. Come back here — this dialog closes automatically.

wizard.perm_input_body:
Input Monitoring lets Click-n-speak detect the global hotkey (Alt+Space).

macOS should be showing a permission dialog right now — click Allow in it.

If no dialog appeared (permission was previously denied), click «Open Settings» to enable it manually.
